Labels.NotParticipating: You are not in this roll-off.

PlayerPrompt.Hint: Or type /roll {die} in chat, or use the Roll-Offs sidebar tab / window.

ShowChatButton.Name: Show Chat Button
ShowChatButton.Hint: Show the Roll-Offs button in the chat controls.

PostPerRollCard.Name: Post Per-Roll Cards
PostPerRollCard.Hint: Post individual rolls to chat, including GM rolls for missing players. Off by default; results remain visible in the panel.

PostRoundAnnouncements.Name: Post Round Announcements
PostRoundAnnouncements.Hint: Announce subsequent rounds in chat. Off by default; the contest start and final results are always posted.

PostTiebreakAnnouncements.Name: Post Tiebreak Announcements
PostTiebreakAnnouncements.Hint: Announce each tiebreak in chat. Off by default; the panel always shows tiebreaks.

DefaultDieType.Name: Default Die Type
DefaultDieType.Hint: Default die type used when starting a new roll-off.

WinsNeeded.Name: Default Wins Needed
WinsNeeded.Hint: Default number of wins needed to win a new roll-off.

ShowSidebarTab.Name: Show Sidebar Tab
ShowSidebarTab.Hint: Show the Roll-Offs tab in the sidebar between Chat and Combat.

IncludeGMByDefault.Name: Include GM by Default
IncludeGMByDefault.Hint: Check the GM as a participant by default when configuring a new roll-off.
